overview_description.description:
Charterscanner is a private jet charter booking platform that enables individuals and businesses to search, compare, and book private aircraft for flights worldwide. The platform digitizes the entire private jet charter process—from submitting a flight request and sourcing aircraft to payment and confirmation—making private aviation more accessible and efficient through technology.

Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, the company operates as a B2C charter marketplace that connects customers directly with hundreds of accredited private jet operators globally. Through its system, users can receive flight quotes within about 30 minutes and choose from a wide range of aircraft suited to their travel needs.

product.name: Private Jet Booking Platform
product.description: An online platform that enables customers to request, source, and book private jet charters from third-party operators within 30 minutes.

product.name: Flight Support Services
product.description: Services providing flight briefs, status updates, weather forecasts, and travel document assistance for private jet customers.

product.name: Operator Accreditation and Safety Verification
product.description: A process ensuring that all private jet operators on the platform meet recognized safety and operational standards.

product.name: Charter Brokerage Service
product.description: An intermediary service that arranges private jet charters between customers and third-party aircraft operators without operating flights directly.
